messages:
Jules: Quick thread FYI on Fenris Systems case story + co-hosted webinar with PartnerX. Key needs: quote approvals, gated transcript access for PR, 4-min live demo, and nuanced lead routing (AE + SDR split). Brief: https://redwood.docs/fenris-case-brief :link:
Kai: I can schedule interviews. Who are spokes? Fenris CTO + Head of Ops and PartnerX product lead (for joint segment). Also want a 30s promo clip.
Monique: Draft pull quote: "Fenris saw strong inference cost and latency improvements after migrating to Redwood Inference." Tag any percent claims with [LEGAL].
Tara: Legal note  avoid raw percentages unless Fenris sends a signed stat email. For the co-host, PartnerX legal must approve use of their name in promo. If Fenris requests transcript gating/NDA, expect +3 business days.
Jules: Routing specifics: during live, primary leads -> AE queue fenris-ae; attendee followups within 24h -> SDR queue fenris-sdr. Also want to set UTM=partnerx so partner leads are flagged. Can we add an "interest" hidden field?
ops-bot: registration form updated: consent checkbox added. Hidden fields added: utm_source=partnerx, interest=product-demo, consent=true. Webhook mapping preview: 
```
POST /webhook -> {campaign: "Fenris-Q4", owner_queue: if(source=="webinar" && role=="ae") then "fenris-ae" else "fenris-sdr", utm_source}
```
Kai: Nice. For split logic, we'll need a routing rule: if attendee selects "Request demo" -> AE, else -> SDR. I'll add a boolean field demo_request.
Monique: Sent quote to Fenris + PartnerX for redline. Also suggested a softer backup line: "meaningful unit-cost reductions" if legal blocks percent.
Tara: If PartnerX requires a two-way NDA for co-host materials, that might introduce a week delay. Ask them if a one-way transcript NDA is acceptable. We'll also need their PR contact on copy approvals.
Jules: Can someone add a consent checkbox copy variant for EU regs? Need GDPR-friendly phrasing: "I consent to Redwood contacting me and to the webinar recording being used for marketing. I understand my data will be processed per the privacy policy."
ops-bot: EU-consent copy added to reg form when geo=EU. SFDC mapping updated: campaign=Fenris-Q4, lead_source=webinar, partner=PartnerX. Test webhook passed in staging.
Kai: Doodle sent with slots Tue/Wed/Thu. Asked for permission to record and for explicit percent confirmation in email if they want numbers included.
Monique: Fenris replied: approved the pull quote but redacted one latency stat; they gave permission to include the percent if we attach their confirmation email. PartnerX wants to review the promo script.
Tara: OK. I'll review PartnerX script and prioritize legal review for Fenris email confirmation if they send it. If Fenris requests transcript redactions after the interview, we should set a 72-hour window before publishing.
Jules: Sales ops note: ensure the webhook sets lead.owner to queue and doesn't overwrite existing owner if lead already has an owner. Also tag leads as partner=true when utm_source=partnerx.
ops-bot: Added SFDC rule: preserve existing owner unless owner=NULL and source=webinar then assign queue. Also added tag partner=true when utm_source contains "partner".
Monique: I'll create two promo cutdowns (30s/60s) and a 2-minute highlights reel for the sales team. Will mark any segments that include verbatim quotes with [LEGAL] so we can swap if needed.
Kai: Recording consent checkbox copies and webhook are all set. Once Fenris sends that confirmation email we'll decide on exact wording (percent vs. conservative language).
Jules: TL;DR: interviews scheduled pending Doodle, legal loop queued for Fenris & PartnerX, reg consent + EU copy in place, routing logic for AE/SDR split done, embargo target Nov 12, publish gating: 72-hour redaction window. Quick check-in tomorrow AM. :rocket:
